newsitem.title: UK: LME copper hits stops, sinks below support.
newsitem.headline: LME copper hits stops, sinks below support.

text.p: Copper prices sliced through support at $2,355 in late trading on Tuesday, triggering sell stops and heading still lower, analysts said.
Three months copper was last quoted at a two-month low of $2,330/$2,335, compared to the kerb close of $2,368 and Monday's finish of $2,399.
In the short term some support was expected in the $2,325-$2,335 area.
Traders said rising stocks and expectations of more increases in coming weeks was putting pressure on sentiment.
The July backwardation was the only factor holding prices up, they added. But as prices fell the cash to threes backwardation contracted by about $10 to $130/$140.
